messages:
Rachel (Marketing): Post-event ops check: we have the cloud recording + raw chat. Need owners for: edit (90s highlight), full archive (with captions), transcript cleanup (PII redaction), and lead routing.
Priya (Events): ZoomBot shows cloud recording complete: https://zoom.us/rec/share/QwE456_example (passcode: red-infer). I'll download and put master MP4 in GDrive archive. Retention policy: move to long-term bucket after 30 days.
ZoomBot: Recording created by host rachel@redwood.ai at 2026-03-xx 15:00 UTC.
Chris (Creative): I can cut the 90s hero clip. Please flag timecodes (the demo starts at ~06:12, the benchmark chart is at ~11:40). I can add captions and our outro. Where should I upload finished assets?
Ava (Ops): Upload final assets to drive.redwood.ai/marketing/webinars/2026-03-lowlatency/ and add folder /archived/2026. Also put captions.srt and transcript.txt. We need transcript with PII redacted: replace email addresses and phone numbers with [redacted].
Leo (Growth): Lead handling: we'll push attendee rows into HubSpot via Segment. Rule: only mark as MQL if watch_pct >= 60 OR filled feedback survey with interest="yes". Everyone who joined gets contact created, but only MQLs get the "webinar:mql" lifecycle stage. HubSpot queue name: "WS - Webinar: Low Latency (Engaged)".
Rachel (Marketing): Good. For social promo: Chris, create a 30s vertical clip for reels and a 90s for LinkedIn. Add utm params: utm_campaign=webinar_lowlatency_2026&utm_source=social&utm_medium=organic. Use utm_content=90s or utm_content=30s accordingly.
Priya (Events): I exported the Zoom attendees report: fields = email, name, company, join_time, leave_time, watch_pct, q&a_count, chat_text. Uploading CSV now to drive.redwood.ai/marketing/exports/2026-03-lowlatency-attendees.csv
Ava (Ops): Automation snippet for Segment -> HubSpot mapping (for ops):
```
Source: Google Drive CSV upload (webhook)
Parse: rows -> map fields
Map: email -> hs_email, name -> firstname
  Properties: webinar_source = "Webinar - Low Latency 2026"
  webinar_attended = true/false
  watch_pct = numeric
  webinar_engaged = true if watch_pct>=60 OR q&a_count>0
Action: Identify call in Segment -> HubSpot identify/track
HubSpot: If webinar_engaged=true -> add to list "WS - Webinar: Low Latency (Engaged)" and trigger Workato workflow to create Task for AE
```
Rachel (Marketing): Follow-up email drafts below. Please review. Short version for attendees: "Thanks for joining! Recording + benchmark PDF inside. If you'd like a demo, we'll send a Calendly to those who watched >=60% or self-report interest." Long version for registrants who missed: "Sorry we missed you. Catch the recording and join office hours for a live Q&A."
Leo (Growth): I suggest we gate Calendly link behind the engaged rule only to reduce noise. For engaged folks we'll send: "Book a 20-min demo: https://calendly.com/redwood/webinar-demo?utm_campaign=webinar_lowlatency_2026". For everyone else, CTA is 'Join office hours' link.
Chris (Creative): Quick ask: include a timestamped list of 3 highlight clips (00:06:12 demo, 00:11:40 benchmark table, 00:18:05 Q&A - pricing). I'll produce 30s cuts for each and a stitched 90s clip.
Priya (Events): Compliance note: if chat contains customer PII, we must scrub before publishing. I'll run a quick grep for email/phone patterns and flag any rows. Ava, can you add a redaction step in the pipeline?
Ava (Ops): Yes. We'll run a simple regex scrub on the transcript and chat exports; replace with [redacted]. Then store the cleaned transcript in /archived/ with a redaction log. Retention: archive for 365 days for customers, then delete unless Legal asks to keep.
Rachel (Marketing): Who's owning the HubSpot task template for Sales? We need subject line + standard bullets.
Tom (Sales): (pings in DM) I can supply the template. Use subject: "Follow up: Redwood webinar - Low Latency" and task body bullets: 1) confirm latency targets 2) send benchmark PDF 3) offer 20-min demo. Assign to AE/SDR based on company size.
Leo (Growth): One more: add UTM tracking on the benchmark PDF link and on the recording redirect so we can attribute downloads/clicks in GA. utm_campaign=webinar_lowlatency_2026, utm_medium=email, utm_source=mailer.
Rachel (Marketing): Great — timeline: Priya downloads + uploads master MP4 and raw CSV within 2 hours. Chris will deliver the 90s + 30s edits by EOD. Ava will implement scrub + Segment mapping and push to HubSpot. Leo will confirm HubSpot list & Workato workflow. Tom provides sales task template. I'll send final email templates and post the archived links here when complete. :white_check_mark:
